name: ask-codex-raycast
title: AI CLI in Raycast
description: A suite of native Raycast chats for your installed AI CLIs, with independent commands, settings, and sessions.
author: bbfss

commands.name: cli-hub
commands.title: AI CLI in Raycast
commands.subtitle: Local AI CLIs
commands.description: Open a local AI CLI or manage its settings from one native Raycast launcher.

commands.title: Codex in Raycast
commands.subtitle: AI CLI in Raycast
commands.description: Chat with your local Codex CLI, with its own saved conversations and model choice.

preferences.name: uiLanguage
preferences.title: Interface Language / 界面语言
preferences.description: Language of extension screens. Raycast system controls and CLI output follow their own language settings.

preferences.name: autoDetectCli
preferences.title: CLI Detection / CLI 自动检测
preferences.label: Automatically find installed CLIs
preferences.description: Check PATH and known installation locations. Manual paths take priority. Turn off to require explicit CLI paths.

preferences.name: liveSearch
preferences.title: Codex Web Search
preferences.description: Allow Codex CLI to use live web search. Other CLIs use their own settings.
preferences.label: Enable live web search

preferences.name: sandboxMode
preferences.title: Codex Sandbox Mode
preferences.description: Codex CLI permissions. Antigravity uses its own plan and sandbox flags.

preferences.name: workingDirectory
preferences.title: Working Directory
preferences.description: Optional absolute path for repository-aware questions. Leave empty to use Codex's default.

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to codex, codex.exe, or codex.cmd. Leave empty for automatic discovery.

preferences.name: agyPath
preferences.title: Antigravity CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the installed agy executable. Uses your existing CLI sign-in.

preferences.name: qoderPath
preferences.title: Qoder CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute executable or Node entrypoint path. Uses this CLI’s own sign-in. Leave empty for automatic discovery.

preferences.name: qoderCnPath
preferences.title: Qoder CN CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute executable or Node entrypoint path. Uses this CLI’s own sign-in. Leave empty for automatic discovery.

preferences.name: workbuddyPath
preferences.title: WorkBuddy CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute executable or Node entrypoint path. Uses this CLI’s own sign-in. Leave empty for automatic discovery.

preferences.name: geminiPath
preferences.title: Gemini CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute executable or Node entrypoint path. Uses this CLI’s own sign-in. Leave empty for automatic discovery.
